channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Nigeria oo muwaadiniinteeda uga digtay inay maraan garoonka Bole ee Addis Ababa sababo caafimaad dartood
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Nigeria ayaa muwaadiniinteeda, gaar ahaan kuwa qaba xanuunno, uga digtay inay safar ku maraan garoonka Bole ee Addis Ababa joogga sare ee magaalada dartiis, kadib markii 16 Nigerian ay sanadkan dhinteen iyagoo sii maraya, sida ay werisay KBC.

item.title: Yemen: ciidamada koonfureed oo ka baxay Bab el-Mandeb iyo garoonka Dhubab, Xuuthiyiintu waa la wareegeen
item.description: Ciidamada Hubaysan ee Koonfurta Yemen ayaa ka baxay garoonka diyaaradaha ee Dhubab iyo deegaanka Bab el-Mandeb ee galbeedka gobolka Taiz, taasoo goobtaas u daysay xoogagga Xuuthiyiinta, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Urdun: saddex nin oo dil lagu xukumay weerarkii kaniisadda Karak ee 9 qof lagu dilay
item.description: Maxkamadda Amniga Dowladda ee Urdun ayaa saddex nin ku xukuntay dil daldalaad ah, kadib markii lagu helay inay fuliyeen weerarkii hubaysnaa ee 23 October lagu qaaday kaniisad ku taal koonfurta dalka, sida ay sheegeen ciidamada Urdun.

item.title: Axmed Madoobe oo u ambabaxaya Garoowe si uu Deni ula falanqeeyo muranka doorashooyinka
item.description: Madaxweynaha Jubaland, Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe), ayaa la filayaa inuu maalmaha soo socda booqasho ku tago Garoowe, si uu Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ugala hadlo khilaafka hannaanka doorashooyinka Soomaaliya, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Soomaaliya oo ka mid noqotay 133 dal oo taageeray qaraarka QM ee hakinta xukunka dilka
item.description: Soomaaliya ayaa codkeeda siisay qaraar uu Guddiga Saddexaad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ansixiyay 13 November 2026, kaas oo dalalka ugu baaqaya inay hakiyaan fulinta xukunka dilka, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Mooyaale: in ka badan 10,000 oo qof oo ku barakacay gudaha Kenya, cudurro ayaa laga cabsi qabaa
item.description: Guddoomiyaha gobolka Marsabit ee Kenya ayaa sheegay in in ka badan 10,000 oo qof ay ku barakaceen gudaha Kenya kadib colaadaha ka socda deegaanka Mooyaale ee xuduudda Itoobiya, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.

item.title: UFC 334: Ciryl Gane oo Josh Hokit ku garaacay go'aan dhammaystiran, kuna haystay koobka miisaanka culus
item.description: Faransiiska Ciryl Gane ayaa difaacay horyaalnimada miisaanka culus ee UFC, kadib markii uu Josh Hokit kaga adkaaday go'aan garsoorayaal oo dhammaystiran (48-47, 48-47, 48-47) ciyaartii ugu weyneyd ee UFC 334 ee Madison Square Garden, New York.

item.title: Australia iyo Filibiin oo Manila ku saxiixday heshiis difaac oo cusub
item.description: Australia iyo Filibiin ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, magaalada Manila ku saxiixay heshiis cusub oo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga ciidamada, iyadoo Filibiin ay khilaaf ba'an kala dhexeeyo Shiinaha Badda Koonfurta Shiinaha.

item.title: Iran: saddex markab oo saliid ah oo miino ku dhacay Hormuz, Bahrain oo dhawaaq digniin ah shiday
item.description: Ciidamada badda ee IRGC ayaa sheegay in laba markab oo saliid sida ay qarxeen oo dab qabsadeen kadib markii ay miino ku dhaceen koonfurta Marinka Hormuz, halka Axaddii, 15 November, dhawaaqyada digniinta ay ka dhawaaqeen Bahrain.

item.title: UFC 334: Kayla Harrison oo Amanda Nunes ku ceejisay wareegga afraad, kuna haysatay koobka
item.description: Kayla Harrison ayaa difaacatay horyaalnimada miisaanka bantamweight ee UFC kadib markii ay wareegga afraad ceejis kaga adkaatay Amanda Nunes, Sabtidii habeennimo garoonka Madison Square Garden ee New York.

item.title: Sacuudiga oo sheegay inuu riday laba gantaal oo Xuuthiyiintu ku ganeen Riyadh
item.description: Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ayaa sheegay in difaaca cirku uu Axaddii, 15 November, riday laba gantaal oo ballistic ah oo Xuuthiyiinta Yemen ay ku ganeen caasimadda Riyadh, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Bilibili Gaming oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Gen.G, kuna guuleysatay koobka adduunka ee League of Legends
item.description: Kooxda Shiinaha ee Bilibili Gaming (BLG) ayaa 3-1 kaga adkaatay kooxda Kuuriyada Koonfureed ee Gen.G finalka koobka adduunka ee ciyaarta elektaroonigga ah ee League of Legends, oo ka dhacay Barclays Center ee New York, waxayna jebisay 4 sano oo ay Kuuriyada Koonfureed ku guuleysanaysay.

item.title: SpaceX oo markii ugu horreysay gacmaha munaaradda ku qabatay Starship ka soo laabtay hawada sare
item.description: Shirkadda SpaceX ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, markii ugu horreysay taariikhda ku qabatay markabka hawada sare ee Starship gacmaha waaweyn ee munaaradda ganitaanka ee Starbase, Texas, kadib markii uu ka soo laabtay safar uu ku wareegay dhulka, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Netanyahu oo ugu baaqay dowlad midnimo, Eisenkot oo ku tilmaamay khiyaamo
item.description: Ra'iisul wasaaraha xilka u sii hayaa ee Israa'iil, Benjamin Netanyahu, ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, mar kale ugu baaqay in isaga iyo Gadi Eisenkot ay dhisaan dowlad midnimo qaran, halka Eisenkot uu baaqaas ku tilmaamay khiyaamo.

item.title: Mirra Andreeva oo Pegula ka badisay, gaartayna finalka WTA Finals
item.description: Ciyaartoyda Ruushka ah ee Mirra Andreeva ayaa 6-3, 6-4 kaga adkaatay Jessica Pegula semi-finalka WTA Finals ee Indian Wells, waxayna noqotay ciyaartoydii ugu da'da yarayd ee gaarta finalka tartankan muddo 22 sano ah.

item.title: Ra'iisul wasaaraha Ciraaq oo xilka ka qaaday sagaal sarkaal oo lagu tuhmay tahriibinta shidaalka
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Ciraaq Cali al-Zaidi ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, xilalka ka qaaday sagaal sarkaal, wuxuuna amar ku bixiyay in cid kasta oo lagu eedeeyay tahriibinta shidaalka ee Jurf al-Sakher loo gudbiyo garsoorka, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Faransiiska: 106,000 qof oo isugu soo baxay dibadbaxyada qaaliga nolosha, sabtidii shanaad oo xiriir ah
item.description: Ku dhawaad 106,000 qof ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, dibadbaxyo ka dhan ah qaaliga nolosha ka dhigay magaalooyinka Faransiiska, oo ay ku jiraan 24,000 oo Paris ah, sida uu sheegay Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha, halka ururrada ardaydu sheegeen 200,000.

item.title: Kalonzo Musyoka oo sheegay inuu taageeri doono musharaxa mideysan ee mucaaradka Kenya ee doorashada 2027
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha xisbiga Wiper, Kalonzo Musyoka, ayaa Sabtidii ku dhawaaqay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu ka tanaasulo hammigiisa madaxweynenimo si uu u taageero musharax keliya oo mucaaradku u soo bandhigo doorashada guud ee Kenya ee 2027, sida ay wariyeen Capital FM iyo KBC.

item.title: Rugby: Wales oo 35-28 kaga adkaatay New Zealand, guushii ugu horreysay tan iyo 1953
item.description: Xulka rugby-ga Wales ayaa Sabtidii magaalada Cardiff 35-28 kaga adkaaday New Zealand tartanka Nations Championship, taas oo ahayd guushoodii ugu horreysay ee ay ka gaaraan All Blacks muddo 73 sano ah.

item.title: Talyaaniga oo Meta ku ganaaxay 805 milyan oo yuuro, kadib markii ay sawirrada isticmaaleyaasha gashay oggolaansho la'aan
item.description: Hay'adda ilaalinta xogta ee Talyaaniga ayaa Sabtidii shirkadda Meta, oo leh Facebook, ku ganaaxday 805 milyan oo yuuro, iyadoo ku eedeysay inay app-ka Facebook ee Android ku gashay sawirrada iyo muuqaallada isticmaaleyaasha iyadoo aan helin oggolaanshahooda gaarka ah.

item.title: Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga oo Antalya ku kala saxiixday heshiis lagu xoojinayo ilaalinta qoysaska iyo adeegyada bulshada
item.description: Wasiirka Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka Soomaaliya, Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi, iyo dhiggeeda Turkiga, Mahinur Özdemir Göktaş, ayaa magaalada Antalya ku kala saxiixday heshiis is-afgarad oo ku saabsan adeegyada bulshada iyo ilaalinta qoysaska, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Mohamed Salah oo noqday gooldhaliyaha ugu badan taariikhda xulka Masar
item.description: Xiddigii hore ee Liverpool, Mohamed Salah, ayaa noqday ciyaaryahanka goolasha ugu badan u dhaliyay xulka Masar, kadib markii uu laba gool u dhaliyay guushii 5-0 ee Malawi ee isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika, sida uu sheegay Liverpool FC.

item.title: Bulgaria oo joojisay hubka ay Ukraine uga bixin jirtay kaydka ciidankeeda
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Bulgaria, Rumen Radev, ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu aanu Ukraine siin doonin hub iyo rasaas laga soo qaado kaydka ciidanka, aanuna ka qayb qaadan doonin maalgelin cusub oo Midowga Yurub, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo keligiis ku sugnaa hoolka shirkii Gogosha Wadahadalka Qaranka – Kuraastii loo diyaariyey ka qaybgalayaasha oo bannaan
item.description: Sawir laga soo qaaday goobta loo diyaariyey shirka Gogosha Wadahadalka Qaranka ayaa muujinaya Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo keligiis fadhiya miiska dhexe ee shirka, iyadoo kuraastii kale ee hoolka ay bannaan yihiin.

item.title: Kenya: qiimaha shidaalka oo aan isbeddelin bisha soo socota, EPRA ayaa sheegtay
item.description: Hay'adda Nidaamisa Tamarta iyo Batroolka ee Kenya (EPRA) ayaa ku dhawaaqday in qiimaha batroolka, diiseelka iyo gaaska aysan isbeddelin muddada 14 November ilaa 15 December, iyadoo dowladdu ay kabid ku bixisay, sida ay werisay The Standard.

item.title: Baraawe oo warshad ogsijiinta caafimaadka soo saarta laga hirgeliyay Isbitaalka Guud
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, xarigga ka jaray warshad cusub oo soo saarta ogsijiinta caafimaadka oo laga dhisay Isbitaalka Guud ee degmada Baraawe, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.

item.title: Soomaaliya iyo Hindiya oo Muqdisho ku bilaabay wada-tashigii ugu horreeyay ee wasaaradaha arrimaha dibadda
item.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dowladda Hindiya ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, magaalada Muqdisho ka bilaabay wada-tashigii ugu horreeyay ee rasmi ah ee u dhexeeya wasaaradaha arrimaha dibadda ee labada dal, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan iyo Suudaan oo Khartoum ku saxiixday heshiis ku saabsan mugga saliidda ceeriin
item.description: Koonfur Suudaan iyo Suudaan ayaa magaalada Khartoum ku saxiixay heshiis is-afgarad (MoU) oo lagu waafajinayo mugga saliidda ceeriin ee labada dal, laguna xoojinayo iskaashiga qaybta batroolka, sida ay werisay Eye Radio Sabtida 14 November.

item.title: Zelensky: Mareykanka ayaa soo jeediyay in Ukraine ka baxdo Donbas si ay u hesho xubinnimada NATO
item.description: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky ayaa sheegay in wada-xaajoodayaasha Mareykanka ay soo jeediyeen fikrad ah in Ukraine ciidamadeeda kala baxdo qaybta Donbas ee ay weli gacanta ku hayso, beddelkeedana ay ku biirto NATO, sida ay werisay BBC iyo warbaahin kale Sabtida 14 November.

item.title: Erdoğan oo Xasan Sheekh ugu baaqay wada-hadal siyaasadeed iyo midnimo qaran
item.description: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud kula hadlay muhiimadda midnimada qaranka iyo wada-hadal siyaasadeed oo lagu xalliyo khilaafka Soomaaliya, sida uu sheegay war ka soo baxay Madaxtooyada Turkiga oo ay soo xigatay Hiiraan Online Sabtida 14 November.
